environment.graph_events: enable_timing=True, external=True, captured INSIDE the segment graph

cache_probe.scope: System-wide non-CPU UCF DRAM; qualification only, not timing runs
cache_probe.note: Empirical streaming eviction proxy, not architectural invalidation or measured physical PIM handoff.

validation.failed_attempt_excluded: pi05_h16_segments_20261108_01: model parameters created inside inference_mode; no valid measurements

suites.native_blocks: Logical native operator blocks, isolated from the full pipeline; do not call their sum E2E.
suites.handoff_composites: Continuous GPU combinations; replace overlapping native block rows, never add both.
suites.pim_interface_candidates: Logical FP32 input variants; not physical PIM output/packing/coherency validation.

pim_reference.note: RoPE is on PIM in that reference. GPU-RoPE cases are alternatives, not an additional cost for PIM-RoPE. Partial-PV sum and logical P parity packing are supplied as GPU candidates.

modes.eager_reused: Native function, external CUDA events; includes host submission gaps; fixed-address reuse control.
modes.eager_entry_cold: One 256MiB .ca eviction before segment, external CUDA events; includes host submission gaps.
modes.graph_reused: Same function captured, external timing events INSIDE CUDA graph; fixed-address reuse control.
modes.graph_entry_cold: One entry eviction, timing INSIDE graph; no internal evictions, no CPU graph-launch/dispatch cost.

limitations: Eviction is an empirically qualified cache-state proxy, not an architectural cache invalidate or real PIM handoff.
Entry eviction also affects GPU-resident constants/weights; their actual residency is not selectively reproduced.
GPU is otherwise idle; concurrent ViT/VLM competition and preemption are not measured.
No guarantee that output has drained to LPDDR or become PIM-visible at the recorded GPU event.
No DMA, host/PIM dispatch, physical bank unpack/pack, or inter-device coherency cost included.
Graph is a separately validated submission mode; original full-model baseline remains native eager.
Each run captures the deterministic fifth step; twenty fixed-buffer repetitions are not twenty distinct model requests.
A hybrid using graph submission needs an equivalently optimized GPU baseline before attributing any E2E speedup solely to PIM.
Summed case means are not a measured denoising step or full AE end-to-end time.
